title: Finspector: A Human-Centered Visual Inspection Tool for Exploring and Comparing Biases among Foundation Models
benchmark_measurement: Stereotype and bias detection in religious contexts using pseudo-log-likelihood scores. The tool 'Finspector' allows users to visually inspect biases across different categories, including religion.
findings: The paper presents a tool, Finspector, capable of inspecting bias related to religion as one of its features. However, the paper's use case analysis and reported findings do not focus on religion and provide no specific results or examples for this category.
